title: Wikipedia and Grokipedia: A Comparison of Human and Generative Encyclopedias

bias_targets.methodology: Modeling the probability of a Wikipedia page being included and subsequently rewritten in Grokipedia using logistic regression based on page-level features like popularity (page views), reference density, and recent editorial activity (edits and reverts).

Using Large Language Models (LLMs) to annotate article lead sections for laudatory or conflict-oriented language, and constructing actor-relation narrative networks using Abstract Meaning Representation (AMR) to measure shifts in sentiment polarity (supportive vs. conflictive relations).

Analyzing shifts in evaluative framing and narrative sentiment for US political figures, explicitly labeling pages by political affiliation (Democrat, Republican, Neutral) to identify localized shifts in positive or conflict-focused language.
